Our DeFi vault smart contract at `/workspace/vault_package` is almost ready for mainnet launch, but the security team has flagged that the test suite is incomplete. Before we deploy, we need full test coverage verified.

Please analyze the current test coverage of the `vault` module, identify exactly which parts of the code are not being tested, and add the missing tests directly to the existing test file at `/workspace/vault_package/tests/vault_tests.move`.

The analysis tools are located in `/workspace/skills/sui-coverage/`. Save the coverage gap analysis as `coverage.md` in the vault package directory.

The goal: every function, every error path, and every conditional branch in the vault module must be exercised by at least one test.
